content: Nen Yahudi Mo Dǝm Kǝ Ɗyeel nkaa Pool
Aɓwoon meeteer mo paat, ɓǝ Ananiyas pris ɗeɗes, jì ashak kǝ pak pris ɗenan mo, kǝ mee Nguɓerepdyeel ɗe sǝm wur a Tartulus, mo dǝm kǝ ɗyeel nkaa Pool pǝ gofna ɗi.

Kaaɗe mo pet Pool, ɓǝ Tartulus ɗoom leshap nkaa Pool nǝnee, <<Waa Feliks ngwe ɗeret met jir. A mbǝ gha, ɗang muu tongriyang, hakyeng, kǝ a mbǝ ɗak ɗeret fwaa mo zak, ɗang yil fun ɗesǝ nǝ ɗee a ɗe ɗak, koo a mpee ɗeɗangyii.
Mbii ɗe a cìn nǝ mo, ɓǝ mu plang ɗes zam, koo a nii, ɓǝ gurum moo plang gha.
Ɗangɓǝ mbǝkǝ taji nle kǝn nghan yool a yaa pwoo a tong mpee ɗesǝ kas, ɓǝ an pǝ ɗang pǝ gha mbǝ ɗeret fwaa, a lekom kǝn nghan kǝlǝng mun ɗi mbǝ reppee lee.
Mu kat gwar ɗesǝ wur a ngu tǝkook kǝ pee, ɗǝ wur le ɓǝlep ɗebish yool nnaar kǝ nnen Yahudi mo. Koo mpee ɗeɗangyii nɗǝǝn yil nǝ. Kǝzak wur a ngu taakyeen mǝ soon mǝ nnen Nazarin mo zak.
Nǝ le gyet wur reɓet le Lu Naan ɗeɗes nǝ ɗee a mbii ɗebuu, ɗang mu yaa wur. Muu reɓet tokɗyeel nwur a shi wàar fun mo.
Ɗangɓǝ gyet ngwe ɗeɗes Lisiyas jì dul wur put kǝnǝ shiɓal nsar fun.

Yaksǝ Lisiyas sat nnen ɗe mo kǝ pwoo nkaa wur nǝ, kǝn mo jì pǝ gha ɗi. Katɗang a tal pwoo mo nkaa mbii ɗe muu sat sǝ mo shikáa fwaa pǝ wur, ɓǝ a mman zeen mǝ pwoo ɗesǝ mo jir, ɗe muu jì kǝ mo nkaa wur.>>
Nen Yahudi mon mɓwoon pwoo ɗe Ngu ɓǝrep ɗyeel nǝ sat, dǝm mo tong a langtǝng nǝ, pwoo ɗe Ngu ɓǝrep ɗyeel sat nǝ mo azeen jir.
Pool Put Kaa Fin Ntoom Kǝ Feliks

Ɓǝ gofna kam sar mPool, mbǝkǝ nwur leshap ɗi. Yaksǝ Pool sat nǝnee, <<Wen man nǝ, waa aa cìn ɓit mo ɗes, ɓǝ gha nkaa tokɗyeel nnen ɗesǝ mo. Mbǝ mǝnǝ ɓǝ an pǝ leshap ɗesǝ nǝ a shi retnyit, mbǝ put kǝ káa fen.
Waa shikáa fwaa a mak bǝlǝp shii mǝnǝ, ɓǝ a mman nǝ, mɓut teer ɗe mo ɗel kaapaat baavǝl sǝ mo, ɓǝ gyet wen nkàa nJerusalem mbǝ seyil nNaan.
Baa nnen Yahudi mo kǝ cam kat an mpwoo kǝ mee gurum nɗǝǝn Lu Naan ɗeɗes kas, kǝ baa mo cam kat wen nle mee gurum ɓwetɓeer kas, koo a nɗǝǝn Lu Naan mo, kǝ koo a nɗǝǝn pee nkaam nǝ kas zak.
Kǝzak, baa mon mmak kám nghan agaak azeen-zeen nkaa mbii ɗe mo ji kǝ dyeel fen pǝ gha yaksǝ nǝ kas.

Ɗangɓǝ nǝ azeen-zeen, an kǝn seyil nNaan mǝ puun fun mo a nɗǝǝn ar ɗe mǝ mo kǝ pet a ɗung. An kǝn seyil nNaan mǝ puun fun mo, ɗang nshinzeen mbii ɗe mo ran mo nɗǝǝn ɓǝǝt-haal mǝ Mosis mo jir. Kǝ mbii ɗe mo ran mo nɗǝǝn ɓǝǝt-haal mǝ nen satpwoo mǝ Naan mo zak.
An kǝn canciin nɗǝǝn Naan, kaaɗe mǝ mo kǝ canciin nɗǝǝn Naan sǝ zak nǝ, mon nyool kǝ gurum mo a peemúut jir, nnen ɗe ndǝre mo, kǝ nen ɗebish mo zak.
A mbǝ canciin mǝnǝ, ɗang an pǝ mbǝ gung, mbǝkǝ nghan tong ɗe shi mǝse ɗeret ntoom kǝ Naan, kǝ ntoom kǝ gurum mo shidaar-shidaar.
<<Aɓwoon mǝ ɓit mo ruk, ɓǝ wen njì kǝ shool mbǝ ɓam nen fen mo, kǝ mbii mo mbǝ wus mbiizuum nNaan zak.

Kaaɗe an nkaa cìn mǝnǝ, ɓǝ mo jì kat an nɗǝǝn Lu Naan ɗeɗes nǝ, ɓǝ kǝn lesen a ɗeɓang. Ɓǝ baa mo kat an ashak kǝ mee kuur gurum mo, ɗe mun nkaa ɗyeep ɗoo koo wat mee mbii mo kas. Gyet pak nnen Yahudi ɗe mo pwat Eshiya mo ɗi.
Katɗang yoo mo kǝ mee pwoo nkaa an, ɓǝ yoo nǝ nret kǝn nnen Yahudi ɗe mo pwat Eshiya sǝ, mo ɗe ntoom fwaa, mbǝ jì kǝ ɗyeel nkaa an nǝ.
An mbǝ reɓet kǝ nnen ɗe mon mpee ɗesǝ shikáa fur kǝn mmo sat mbii ɗebish ɗe mo kat nɗǝǝn an, kaaɗe ɗe nɗar ntoom nenɗyeel mo sǝ ɗi.
Ɗee a mbii mǝndong, ɗe ɗiyeep ɗoo fen nnaar mo, ɓǝ a an sat mmo nǝnee, <A mbǝ pwoo nkaa yool a peemúut, ɗang wun bǝ tokɗyeel nghan ntoom fuu cicinsǝ, ɓejee ɗak.> >>
Mo Le Pool Nlushoot
Ɗangɓǝ mbǝɗe Feliks pan man pwoo nkaa ar nǝ rǝret, ɓǝ wur ɗar kǝ ɗyeel nǝ. Wur sat nǝnee, <<Katɗang parpuus ɗe Lisiyas ngwe ɗeɗes mǝ shiitoon mo jì wul, ɓǝ an nsǝǝt nnaa pwoo fuu nǝ.>>
Wur sat ngwe ɗeɗes nkaa shiitoon mo, kǝ nwur tap kǝ Pool, ɗang wur shínpee mPool, taji mo daampee nshaar mǝ Pool mo mbǝ jì cìn ɓam nwur kas.

Aɓwoon pak meeteer mo, ɓǝ Feliks jì ashak kǝ mat fin Drusila, ɗe war a reep Yahudi. Yaksǝ wur lep mmo dǝm jì kǝ Pool. Feliks lekom kǝn nwur kǝlǝng pwoo ɗe Pool nkaa sat nǝ, ɗe nǝ a mǝ shinzeen nɗǝǝn Jesu Kristi.

Pool leshap nkaa tong ɗe ndǝre-ndǝre, kǝ ngurum yaashin, kǝ pwoo nkaa tokɗyeel ɗe nǝn mbǝ jì. Ɓǝ kǝǝrmuut yaa Feliks, nǝ le nwur sat mPool nǝnee, <<A mak seet yaksǝ aku, katɗang parpuus ɗe nkatpee, ɓǝ an mbǝ pet gha zak.>>
Feliks leɗyeen nǝ, tong Pool mbǝ shin a shool nɗyin, a nǝ le ɗang wur naa mpet Pool shidaar-shidaar, mbǝkǝ nwur leshap ɗe kǝ nwur.
Aɓwoon ɓit mo vǝl, ɓǝ Poncus Festus wur kaa a gofna a koppee Feliks. Gyet a mbǝɗe Feliks reɓet kǝn nnen Yahudi mo ɗee a shaar fin mo, a nǝ le ɗang gyet wur yit Pool nɗǝǝn lushoot.
